sourceTitle: Town of Hinton - Request for Proposal - CCTV & Security System Upgrades at Hinton Rec Centre
sourceFact: CanadaBuys tender notice describes Hinton’s Dr. Duncan Murray Recreation Centre CCTV/security upgrade: replacing 16 cameras and increasing facility total to 60, plus PA, panic button and motion-sensor elements; scope includes supply, installation, configuration and staff handover/training.
planningQuestion: For any Hinton project, ask whether the facility has a current camera/device inventory, integration requirements, commissioning records and staff handover needs. This is historical tender evidence, not a statement of current system condition, municipal policy, Fortega availability, or a general town-wide fact.

sourceTitle: 26-038 RDN Access Control, CCTV and Alarm Systems Consultant
sourceFact: The Regional District of Nanaimo invited statements of qualifications for consulting to select a system for consolidating access control, CCTV and alarm systems, and identify a provider for supply, support, implementation and ongoing operation.
planningQuestion: For a project in the district, ask whether systems are consolidated or separate, what interoperability and support requirements apply, and who owns ongoing operation. This procurement is regional district-specific, not evidence of Nanaimo city policy or Fortega availability.
